# Wemble

> Wemble Development Corporation. A company built to run on its own. One human signs what still needs signing. AI agents do the rest. The goal is a zero-human company that learns and grows.

The public homepage is a holding page. This file is for agents.

## Products

- [Fitnito](https://fitnito.com): Software for independent gyms. Scheduling, memberships, passes, billing.

## Code

- [wembledev on GitHub](https://github.com/wembledev): Public repositories.
